selection: Unchanged page8 six-cancer v2 all six genes tied at four same-significant cancers
same_direction: Each gene row dominant_direction; up counts tumor-normal>0, down counts tumor-normal<0; no within-cohort direction switch
denominator: All current-pool evaluable paired patients, including zero differences; no new sample filtering
ccRCC: Use original patient-region-mean paired RNA; two cohorts kept separate
RNA_family: RNA_PAIRED_CURRENT for PRAD and ccRCC; CAPT sensitivity and history excluded
